title: maint.event.v1{kind=scale_decision}
description: Phase 8 §8.2 — notification emitted by maint.scaler.v1 each time a target's replica count is decided. NOT operator-driven; carries no request_id and expects no acks. `decision_window_id` is `<pod_instance_id>:<window_anchor_ns>` so a leadership flip after restart cannot collide window ids in the audit ledger.

target.description: Agent id whose replica count was set.

signals.description: Original input signals (queue_depth, in_flight, head_age_s, etc.).

request_id.description: Set when source=manual_pin or retrain_request_warmup; correlates back to the originating operator/drift request.
